acquisitionCoverage.byteAccounting: Connector Size metadata. Failed read/parse attempts consume the read-attempt and requested-byte budgets.
acquisitionCoverage.fileAccounting: Read attempts include failures; fetched files count connector successes; filesRead/filesWithReturnedEvidence count returned evidence records, not complete-file review.
acquisitionCoverage.inventoryCompleteness: Connector-returned entries only, not an independent archive preflight or proof of complete archive enumeration.
acquisitionCoverage.modelInventoryBoundary: Only the first 25 inventory rows are supplied to the model; total inventory count is metadata, not proof that omitted rows were reviewed.
acquisitionCoverage.nestedDiscoveryScope: Validated entries in the bounded outer inventory, not proof of the total nested apps in a partial archive.
acquisitionCoverage.transportPolicy: Initial extraction POST and content reads are not replayed. Metadata/continuation GETs have at most two native exponential retries for transient/throttled responses. Content actions are paced one second; their failure still consumes the declared content budget. Extraction uses explicit bounded continuation, not an unbounded Location follow.

allOmissionsAndReasons.reason: Identifiable .pa.yaml candidates occur outside an extracted Src folder. Review their actual extracted paths, never invent Src prefixes or call them legacy solely for that reason. Flattening/path loss is possible; original member mapping, collisions, missing source and full app coverage cannot be excluded or certified.
Source is empty, over a declared budget, or deferred after connector throttling. Not reviewed; remaining content requests stop after HTTP 429 rather than racing the server Retry-After window.

componentAssessmentAccounting: FIRST and REPAIR phase records include skipped phases. Count nativeInvocationAttempted/modelResponseReceived fields, not array length, to distinguish execution from preparation failure or an unnecessary repair.

componentAssessmentAttempts.accountingBoundary: Two phase records are not model-call counts. A second invocation is either FORMATTING_REPAIR or EMPTY_RESPONSE_RETRY; the latter reuses the first grounded message unchanged. Both consume the same maximum two-invocations-per-source budget; no third attempt exists.
componentAssessmentAttempts.diagnosticRetentionBoundary: A complete or explicitly bounded/redacted private transport diagnostic is attempted before citation normalization. Metadata presence/neutral-shape flags are not auth payloads or proof of an authentication challenge.

counts.note: These are actual record/pass counts, not invented finding/control counts. Lists can overlap; excerpts are not complete-original-file or runtime coverage.

deliveryBoundary: The saved main report, complete component section files and inventory/coverage appendices form the authoritative full available report. Email is only a link. Missing passes and meaningful unreviewed content make the report PARTIAL.

detailedSectionsUnavailable.reason: No accepted source assessment is available. Preparation/data errors are pipeline failures, not model defects or evidence that the package needs replacement. FIRST/REPAIR accounting distinguishes skipped phases, actual invocation attempts and invalid responses.

fullDetailedSectionsSaved.scope: Returned source excerpt only; not complete original-file/app/runtime assurance. Semantic human evaluation remains necessary.

mainHistoryHandling: Separate unvalidated diagnostics only, never merged into the authoritative final narrative.

officialChecker.embeddedSarif: Presence is not implied. Only returned sources with category embedded-checker constitute imported SARIF evidence; absent such a source, no embedded checker was acquired.
officialChecker.historicalEvidencePolicy: Any actually acquired embedded SARIF is historical publication-time evidence, never a current checker execution.

parserAndRules: Native UTF-8 decoding, SARIF JSON parsing and bounded solution.xml RootComponent XML/XPath metadata extraction only. No Power Fx semantic parser, runtime execution or current official checker.
secretsPolicy: No raw source excerpts are copied into these appendices. Model report text must redact secret-like values; all artifacts remain private.
